report_text_extracts.management_discussion: During FY2025, consolidated revenue expanded by 8.4% to ₹5.8B driven by broad adoption of cloud enterprise platforms. However, net profit after tax experienced a contraction of 4.2% to ₹650M due to higher personnel restructuring costs and increased debt service costs. Total long-term borrowings were scaled up to support capital expenditures in hyperscale infrastructure.
report_text_extracts.risk_factors: The company increased total leverage during the period, resulting in a higher debt-to-equity ratio of 1.42. Working capital requirements expanded, moderating the current ratio to 1.45. Foreign exchange volatility and software license churn remain monitoring items.
important_statements: Consolidated top-line revenue expanded to ₹5.8B in FY2025 from ₹5.35B in FY2024, representing an 8.4% year-over-year increase.
Net profit declined 4.2% to ₹650M compared to ₹678.5M in the prior financial year.
Gross debt expanded to ₹4,200M, taking the debt-to-equity ratio to 1.42 against 1.15 in FY2024.
Cash flow from operations remained resilient at ₹910M, demonstrating sustained operating cash generation.
Management allocated ₹720M toward infrastructure capital expenditures during FY2025.
